'''Assimilated Endermen''' are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Endermen. 
Killing one grants the {{AdvancementLink|Controversial}}.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when an Enderman succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive|Call of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns individually, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] to [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 1, once 9 Endermen have been assimilated and the End has reached [[Evolution Phases#Phase 3|Phase 3]].
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Endermen are Hit and Run Offensive Support units and Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, which has a 20% chance to inflict [[Bleeding]] for 5 seconds.
* If the [[Generations|Generation]] is 4 or higher, Assimilated Enderman can perform the following abilities:
** Teleport themselves as well as nearby [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]]. Their teleportation Ability is based on the following logic:
*** Upon sight of a Player, the teleportation noise will play.
*** Assimilated Endermen cannot teleport within the first 4 seconds of finding a target.
*** Assimilated Endermen will not teleport if within 10 blocks of the target.
*** 2 damage will be inflicted to the teleported mob (unless it is another Assimilated Enderman)
*** The ability to teleport other Parasites has a cooldown of 2 seconds. This cooldown is removed if the Assimilated Enderman takes damage or has the [[Rage]] effect.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Enderman will be inflicted with COTH. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Endermen are immune to ranged attacks, teleporting away from Projectiles, similar to their Sane counterpart.
* Assimilated Endermen are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Endermen are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Enderman gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding Assimilated Ender Dragon and Assimilated Big Spider.</ref>, it will evolve into a [[Moving Flesh]].
* If an Assimilated Enderman gets 60 kills and is unable to turn into Moving Flesh, it will evolve into a [[Feral Enderman]].
* On death, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Enderman will drop its [[Walking Enderman Head|Head]].
{{Variants|count=1|Texture=Crawling Enderman .png|TextureName=Crawling|TextureDesc=is in crawling position, having a smaller hitbox able to fit in 1x1.5x1 spaces.}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Endermen, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* The head of an Assimilated Enderman functions as a Weak Point. When this Weak Point is hit, damage inflicted to it is increased by 25%.
* Similar to their Sane counterpart, Assimilated Endermen take damage in water.
* If the Assimilated Enderman is on fire, there is a 75% chance the mob it teleports will also catch fire.

== ''Trivia'' ==
* Assimilated Endermen are known as '''Infenderman''' in the mod files.
* The Assimilated Enderman's animation was inspired by [https://deadspace.fandom.com/wiki/Twitcher Twitchers], Necromorphs from Dead Space.
* Assimilated Endermen has received many complaints and hate for its Abilities, missing weakness and Statistics. It is in fact one, if not the most hated [[Mobs|Mob]] this Mod introduces. 
** This is also the reason killing it grants the "Controversial" Advancement, due to the debates and controversy over it.
